# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `redo` MCP server pointing at Redo's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.getredo.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Redo sign-in — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Redo's official mark, the 256×256 app icon from redo.com.
